name: new-app
description: Quick-fire new app idea inside the factory. Delegates to the existing factory-new-app skill flow (spec refinement, market sanity, brand pack, template stamp), then runs as a quickfire rig where the marketing loop judges viability. Not executed by the run engine step-by-step; the orchestrator drives the factory-new-app skill and registers the resulting apps/<name> as a quickfire rig.

steps.note: Orchestrator runs the factory-new-app skill (spec -> founder spec gate -> stamp template). Resulting app dir becomes rig factory:<name>.
Subsequent feature work on the new app uses workflow feature-dev with rig factory:<name> (quickfire tier: template checks only, no agentic review loop by default).
